_comment: Same-named attributes that IFC4 RETYPED IN PLACE between a STEP enumeration and a string (#10778). An upgrade writes the enum member as a label ('EUR'); a downgrade writes a label that names a member as that member (.EUR.) and anything else as $, counted as a dropped value and, for a required slot, by the IFC2X3 required-slot warning. `members` is the IFC2X3 enumeration, held to packages/codegen/schemas/IFC2X3_TC1.exp by the Rust test. Pinned in both twins: rust/export/src/schema_retyped.rs compares its table with this file, and packages/export/src/schema-converter-retyped.test.ts converts every member both ways and every other three-letter code to $. DO NOT hand-edit to make a test pass.

slots.why: IFC2X3 Currency is IfcCurrencyEnum; IFC4 IfcMonetaryUnit: 'Type of the attribute Currency changed.' IFC4 Currency is an IfcLabel: 'the three-letter alphabetic currency codes as per ISO 4217'
